source_notes: Taiwan (ROC) per docs/08: fortified defender, US-supplied western lineage early, indigenous (AIDC/NCSIST/CSBC) from the 1980s embargo onward. Strong epochs 4-6. Explicit gaps are deliberate data: no bombers (a few 1950s B-25/B-26 retired without replacement), no tankers, no SSNs, no IFV until 2019, SPAAG frozen at the M42, and a fleet that kept WWII hulls into the 1990s. Naval entries use mass_t in tonnes (full load; submarines submerged) and road_range_km as cruising range; aircraft use ferry range and MTOW. Cross-faction anchors: F-16A/B Block 20 and F-16V match the US file; M113/M109/HAWK/Patriot figures match any other operator. Compiled from memory without web access, 2026-08; every uncertain figure is flagged in estimated_fields and every shaky entry is marked confidence:low for a later referenced pass. | 2026-08 normalization: measurement conventions per data/factions/CONVENTIONS.md (aircraft mass=MTOW; combat-aircraft range=combat radius with attested ferry kept in ferry_range_km; support-aircraft range=max unrefuelled range; helicopter len=fuselage with rotor_diameter_m separate and width=max airframe width; tank len=gun-forward; ship and submarine height=draught; submarine mass=submerged displacement; towed pieces carry null road range). Epoch boundaries follow the fielded-in-numbers policy (a system entering in the last ~year of an epoch sits where it was fielded in numbers); converted fields carry '| conv 2026-08' or '| audit 2026-08' notes in basis.
